loginCopy: Manage Kubernetes workspaces, SSH, Web Shell, and cascading credentials. The API token stays in this browser session.
noOrganizationAdmin: Create an organization, then refresh the console.
noOrganizationMember: Ask an organization administrator to add you.
keyHint: Choose a recognizable name; Unicode is allowed, for example “Windows gaming PC key”
encodingHelp: Use UTF-8 for text; encode binary files as Base64.
fileModeHelp: Linux file mode, such as 644 for configuration or 600 for private files.
targetHelp: Enter a variable name for environment variables or an absolute workspace path for files.
ownerHelp: Optional Linux user name for the materialized file.
groupHelp: Optional Linux group name for the materialized file.
templateSelectorHelp: Optional; inject only into workspaces created from the selected template.
labelSelectorHelp: Optional; inject only when all workspace properties match. No JSON required.
noSelector: No conditions; applies to all workspaces matching the scope and template.
templateSelectorHint: Select a template or leave empty
multilineHint: Whitespace and trailing newline are preserved
sensitiveHelp: Envelope-encrypts storage and materializes as a Kubernetes Secret; plaintext is never returned or audited.
lockedHelp: Organization administrators can prevent user and workspace entries with the same name.
credentialWriteOnly: Values are write-only after saving. The UI and audit log show metadata and versions only.
sshTargetHelp: The SSH target is a platform-managed filename. Reconciliation rewrites it into the runtime user's .mwc directory and aggregates it into authorized_keys.
workspaceAutocomplete: Type a name or short ID to find a workspace
name: Name
templatePersistenceHelp: A template fully declares image, user and home, resources, access, features, permissions, and placement; creation saves an immutable snapshot.
internalHelp: SSH is exposed only through the cluster network or Tailnet; no public jump-host authorization is created.
publicHelp: Allows the shared public SSH jump host and Web Shell entry; it still does not allocate a public port 22 per workspace.
selectedReferenceHelp: Only reference metadata is shown; credential values are never returned. Template and applicability conditions remain enforced by the server.
searchWorkspacesHint: Filter by name, short ID, state, image, or user
noMatchingWorkspaces: No workspaces match the current filter.
sshConnectionIntro: Add the host block to your local SSH config first, then connect through its alias. Codex App should use that same alias.
codexAppAliasHelp: Use the SSH alias as the Codex App hostname. Leave the port blank so SSH reads it from the config.
sshConfigInstallHelp: Append the full block to ~/.ssh/config and verify the fingerprint before accepting the host key.
storageTelemetryDisabled: Storage usage telemetry is not configured
adminOnly: This area is visible only to system administrators and administrators of the current organization.
noQuotaPermission: Only system or organization administrators can change quota.
workspaceHighRiskConfirm: This workspace will receive cluster-management privileges. Create it?
deleteWorkspaceConfirm: Delete this workspace? Its PVC and namespace will be removed.
revokeMemberConfirm: Revoke this user's membership and new SSH access?
templateHighRiskConfirm: This template will grant cluster-management privileges. Create it?
disableTemplateConfirm: Disable this template? Existing workspaces are kept.
deleteTemplateConfirm: Permanently delete this disabled template if no workspace references it?
initialTokenPrompt: Initial API token (at least 32 bytes; write-only)
workspaceUserHelp: Existing non-root image user used for SSH login and file ownership.
workspaceHomeHelp: PVC mount path and HOME for the workspace user; it must be absolute.
templateYamlHelp: YAML is the authoritative persisted template and is parsed and validated by the server.
templateNameHelp: A recognizable template name shown during workspace creation; Unicode is allowed.
templateImageHelp: The OCI image fixed by this template; it must be in the image allowlist.
ephemeralHelp: Temporary Pod root-filesystem space, excluding the persistent workspace disk; blank means unspecified.
preserveHomeOwnershipHelp: Keep the existing owner and mode of the PVC mount root instead of normalizing them.
buildkitHelp: Attach a rootless image builder; buildctl can build OCI images from Dockerfiles without a Docker daemon or host Docker socket.
maintenanceAccessHelp: Only for explicitly authorized maintenance templates; mounts an in-cluster access identity.
nodeListHelp: Comma-separated Kubernetes node names; leave blank for no constraint.
keyValueLinesHelp: Enter one KEY=value per line; values may contain additional equals signs.
pluginsRestartNotice: Plugin packages load at service startup; restart the service after changing a package.
pluginsRestartDetail: This console only manages declarative configuration for loaded plugins. It cannot upload Wasm, run plugin JavaScript, or embed arbitrary HTML.
pluginsEmptyHint: Operations supplies packages through a controlled mount; runtime uploads are intentionally unavailable.
pluginSchemaChanged: The plugin schema changed. Workspace creation fails closed until this scope is reviewed and saved.
pluginConfigurationInvalid: The effective configuration does not satisfy the plugin schema. Correct and save it.
pluginSensitiveGuidance: Plugin configuration must not store passwords, tokens, keys, or other secrets. Use envelope-encrypted credential injection instead.
pluginDeleteOverrideConfirm: Delete this override and restore the inherited configuration?
pluginOverrideDeleted: The override was deleted and inherited values are effective again.
pluginSchemaRejected: The plugin configuration schema exceeds the safe declarative-form subset and was not rendered.
pluginSensitiveSchemaRejected: The schema contains a sensitive field. Plugin configuration cannot store credentials; use credential injection.
pluginValidationInvalid: Value does not satisfy this field's constraints
pluginVersionConflict: Another administrator updated this configuration. Close and reopen it before saving.
pluginInvalidConfiguration: The configuration did not pass server-side schema validation.
pluginNotFound: The plugin is not loaded or was removed after a service restart.
invalidFileMode: File mode must be three octal digits with one optional leading zero, such as 600 or 0644.
templateEnvironmentDialogHelp: These organization-scoped items apply only to this template and use the credential cascade's encryption, locking, and reconciliation.
templateEnvironmentSelectorHelp: This item is fixed to the current template.
deleteCredentialUnavailable: The current backend cannot delete this credential
deleteCredentialConfirm: Delete this credential? Related workspaces will be reconciled.
saveTemplateBeforeEnvironmentFiles: Save the template before configuring environment variables and files that apply only to it.
noTemplateEnvironmentFiles: This template has no dedicated environment variables or files
invalidTemplateNumber: A resource value is empty, outside the allowed range, or not aligned to its field step.
resourceRequestExceedsLimit: CPU and memory requests cannot exceed their respective limits.
ephemeralRequestExceedsLimit: The ephemeral-storage request cannot exceed its limit.
deleteCredentialConfirm: Permanently delete this credential or file item? Affected workspaces will be reconciled.
deleteCredentialUnavailable: This server version does not provide the credential deletion endpoint yet.
